subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving immutable-container install path for official external channel plugins whose package and install record live outside the mounted runtime state directory?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the fix decides which external channel plugins receive trusted host-managed persistent state and channel ingress APIs, so automation should not choose the permanent trust and storage contract.

options.title: Design Immutable Official Plugin Root
options.body: Add a supported official-plugin package/provenance root or install-record import path that preserves catalog/install identity without trusting raw load paths.

options.title: Keep Same-State Requirement
options.body: Document that trusted official plugins must be installed into the same active OpenClaw state directory used at runtime, leaving immutable-image plus mounted-state deployments unsupported for now.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Keyed-State Policy
options.body: Defer this issue until maintainers decide the wider community/plugin keyed-state capability model across https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76433 and related reports.

recommendation.title: Design Immutable Official Plugin Root
recommendation.body: Add a supported official-plugin package/provenance root or install-record import path that preserves catalog/install identity without trusting raw load paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already stated the fail-closed trust-model intent for this issue, making them the best current owner for the boundary decision.
